dolly_in.when: Use it to move closer to a subject for a steady, direct approach.
dolly_in.feel: The viewer feels drawn forward, a small step closer to the subject.

dolly_out.when: Use it to pull back and show a subject within its surroundings.
dolly_out.feel: The viewer feels a gentle step back, as if moving away from the subject.

dolly_left.when: Use it to slide sideways past a subject while keeping it in view.
dolly_left.feel: The viewer feels a short glide to the left, about one unit of travel.

dolly_right.when: Use it to slide sideways past a subject while keeping it in view.
dolly_right.feel: The viewer feels a short glide to the right, about one unit of travel.

dolly_zoom_in.when: Use it to keep the subject roughly framed while the background stretches away.
dolly_zoom_in.feel: The camera moves in as the lens widens, so the background seems to pull away.

dolly_zoom_out.when: Use it to keep the subject roughly framed while the background moves closer.
dolly_zoom_out.feel: The camera pulls back as the lens narrows, so the background looks flatter.

crane_up.when: Use it to reveal more of a scene by rising above a subject.
crane_up.feel: The viewer feels lifted up slowly, about one unit higher.

crane_down.when: Use it to lower the viewpoint for a lower angle on a subject.
crane_down.feel: The viewer feels lowered slowly, about one unit down.

orbit_left.when: Use it to see a subject from a new side with a partial turn around it.
orbit_left.feel: The viewer feels a slow arc to the left, about an eighth of a full circle.

orbit_right.when: Use it to see a subject from a new side with a partial turn around it.
orbit_right.feel: The viewer feels a slow arc to the right, about an eighth of a full circle.

pan_left.when: Use it to turn toward something just outside the frame without moving.
pan_left.feel: The viewer's gaze turns left by 30 degrees while the camera stays put.

pan_right.when: Use it to turn toward something just outside the frame without moving.
pan_right.feel: The viewer's gaze turns right by 30 degrees while the camera stays put.

tilt_up.when: Use it to follow a subject upward or show height above the frame.
tilt_up.feel: The viewer's gaze lifts up by 20 degrees while the camera stays put.

tilt_down.when: Use it to follow a subject downward or show the ground in front.
tilt_down.feel: The viewer's gaze drops down by 20 degrees while the camera stays put.
